name: Parada de Arriba (Spain)
description: Square red flag with a white cross throughout, charged at the crossing with the crowned municipal arms of Parada de Arriba (a cross of Saint James and a bull on red).
history: The municipal flag of Parada de Arriba was approved on 3 May 1993 and is red with a white cross whose stripes reach the edges; the arms were published in the Boletín Oficial de la Provincia de Salamanca on 1 December 2016.

features.role: Parada de Arriba arms — cross of Saint James and bull on red
